size_meaning: Total current Native planning targets (product root:size) in the global source after seeding, including pre-existing products and the one WIP fixture target. Seeding adds size minus current; it never removes or hides a target.

STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_8S.where: existing authenticated statement limit (PostgREST role setting); SQL path sets the same 8s per public call

HISTORY_SOURCE_PRODUCTS_1000.where: scripts/cp7-src/planning/history-source.sql (more than 1000 current products: status INCOMPLETE); planning/history.sql history_build refuses

HISTORY_GRID_100000.where: planning/history.sql and demand/history.sql: products x history days

NETTING_WORK_100000.where: planning/netting.sql: more than 1000 WIP positions or positions x baseline rows above 100000

SUPPLY_SCOPE_1000.value: 1000 scope ids per kind (cutting groups not proven exhausted), 20000 posted cutting groups classified, 20000 facts
SUPPLY_SCOPE_1000.where: planning/supply-source.sql (supply v2: exhausted groups listed in production_scope.exhausted_cutting_groups)

SEGMENT_2000000_CODE_POINTS.where: planning/analysis-jobs.sql segment cut; a cut, never a refusal

BODY_8000000_BYTES.where: per segment; above it the panel switches from the single body to the same run's segments

CLIENT_DOCUMENT_64000000_BYTES.where: src/nativeAnalysisTransport.ts ANALYSIS_DOCUMENT_UTF8_BYTES; the client refuses the whole document

synthetic_inputs.label: P19_SCALE_SYNTHETIC_NOT_FACTORY_DEFAULT
synthetic_inputs.profile_reason: P19 scale synthetic selected profile; not a factory default
synthetic_inputs.policy_reason: P19 scale synthetic ACTIVE review; not a factory default
synthetic_inputs.sale_reason: P19 scale synthetic sale history through the ordinary Native sale writer
synthetic_inputs.wip_fixture: one accepted cp7_analysis_cases.setup fixture: BB opening WIP 8 pcs, reviewed 9/10 yield, 45 work minutes

writers.products_and_opening_fg: BB opening-balance importer (erp_save_initial_import_action_v1 CREATE/SAVE_FILE/VALIDATE/FINALIZE), at most 5000 rows per batch
writers.sales: erp.save_sale_draft_v2 then erp.post_sale_v2, at most 100 lines per note (the CP7 sale form bound)
writers.profiles: erp_cp7_get_planning_profiles_v1 (200 roots per read) and erp_cp7_save_planning_profile_v1
writers.commercial_skus: erp_save_sku_action_v1 SAVE_GROUPS (30 groups per call, one model's sizes per group)
writers.policies: erp_cp7_get_production_policy_v1 (200 per read) and erp_cp7_set_production_policy_v1 (100 per call)
writers.calendar: erp_cp7_save_production_schedule_v1 through the P19 native-load reviewed workload calendar

owner_latency_targets.heavier: background job only as an owner-named exception; the analysis job is not a named exception

browser.device: desktop Chromium 1440x1000, Asia/Jakarta, loopback API, no throttling
browser.context: fresh signed-in browser context per click (cold client state, warm database)

phase_diagnostics.purpose: Attribute which step stops a size: demand history alone, then supply (baseline+history+WIP normalisation) alone, under the same 8 s. Not the latency of the analysis click.
phase_diagnostics.known_finding: PL-8: wip normalize_cutting is quadratic in historical cutting groups (local 250 groups 8.6 s, 500 groups 31.6 s); exhausted groups still emit zero-quantity positions; netting refuses more than 1000 positions. The ladder seeds no cutting group; pre-existing groups are counted, never removed.

phase_profile.label: PHASE_PROFILE_NOT_APP_LATENCY
phase_profile.order: after every measured point and step diagnostic of the size, so no measured call is warmed or delayed by it
phase_profile.actor: the measured capture's actor claims (seeded owner), as inside the security-definer public RPC
phase_profile.isolation: own rolled-back savepoint; intermediates in a temporary table; nothing survives
phase_profile.timing: server clock_timestamp() around the call only; inputs are read before the clock starts
phase_profile.build_input: stored facts of the measured ordinary run when it completed (rebuild compared with the stored result), else the profile's own live source

own_cost_layers.meaning: history source read (products, stock, sales, journals)
serve: source re-read for freshness + labels

phase_profile.original_breakdown: Original, analysis and stored-facts top-level keys by PostgreSQL text bytes, with bytes per target
phase_profile.scaling: own cost per layer across sizes: ms per target and growth exponent between consecutive sizes

sql_ladder.where: committed browser copy, after the measured clicks of each size
sql_ladder.transaction: one per size, rolled back; captures and Originals are not kept

harness_transactions.reason: The first full runs stopped with 'out of shared memory / max_locks_per_transaction' because thousands of writer calls (each CP7 writer takes pg_advisory_xact_lock per request) ran in one transaction. The real app runs one RPC per transaction.
harness_transactions.browser_copy_prepare: one committed transaction per writer call (BB batch, each sale draft and post, each profile/SKU/policy call, calendar review)
harness_transactions.browser_copy_measure: one rolled-back transaction per size, after that size's measured clicks
harness_transactions.native_case: one rolled-back savepoint in the closed harness: first size only, its measured points and a grid-cap refusal
harness_transactions.every_declared_size_and_day_measured: sizes 100/300/1000/5000 x days 1/30/100 (and 1000x101) on the committed browser copy; the native case adds 100x1 and 100x1001 in the closed harness
